sources.name: claude-code-solo-builder (this repo — source of truth)
sources.description: The source of truth for the scaffold skill, 11 agents, 18 commands, 7 workflow recipes, 9 guardrail scripts, user-level hook scripts, and settings templates. ~/.claude is a COPY of this repo.
sources.note: Propagation chain: repo -> ./install.sh -> ~/.claude -> /sync-project per app. The SessionStart hook (solo-builder-session-check.sh) warns when ~/.claude has drifted from the repo. Personal overrides go in ~/.claude/sync-skills/sources.local.json (merged at runtime, local wins by id).

sources.name: gstack skills
sources.description: 30+ workflow automation skills (browse, ship, qa, investigate, etc.)
sources.note: Only skill suite with a git remote and VERSION file. Update via gstack-upgrade.

sources.name: mattpocock/skills
sources.description: Session-layer atomic workflow skills (diagnose, grill-with-docs, handoff, etc.). Upstream now ships as a Claude Code plugin — prefer the plugin install going forward.
sources.note: Installed as a manual copy (no git). Upstream has moved to plugin-marketplace distribution: `claude plugin marketplace add mattpocock/skills`. Migrate when consolidating skills.

sources.name: Context7 MCP
sources.description: Fresh library docs on demand via @upstash/context7-mcp
sources.note: Uses @latest — always pulls newest on each invocation. No manual update needed.

sources.name: Vault Files MCP (optional vault module)
sources.description: Filesystem MCP server for vault access — only relevant if the vault module is enabled (docs/VAULT.md)
sources.note: Uses @latest — always pulls newest on each invocation. No manual update needed.

sources.name: @openai/codex CLI
sources.description: OpenAI Codex CLI — adversarial code review and second-opinion tool

sources.name: superpowers (official plugin)
sources.note: Process-skills framework (brainstorming, systematic-debugging, writing-plans, TDD). Version from ~/.claude/plugins/installed_plugins.json; if it reads 'unknown', fall back to gitCommitSha/lastUpdated. Update via `claude plugin update` — never git-clone a second copy.

sources.name: Other official plugins (metadata-only)
sources.note: Tracked for freshness reporting only. Versions from ~/.claude/plugins/installed_plugins.json (gitCommitSha/lastUpdated fallback for entries whose version reads 'unknown'). Updates go through `claude plugin update <name>` — sync-skills never modifies plugins.
